company.name: Veza
company.shortDescription: Veza is a data security platform that helps users use and share their data safely.
company.description:
Veza is the data security platform that helps users use and share their data safely. It makes it easy to understand, manage, and control who can and should take what action on what data. It organizes authorization metadata across identity providers, data systems, cloud service providers, and applications, all to address the toughest data security challenges of the modern era.

The company is funded by top-tier investors including Accel, Bain Capital, Ballistic Ventures, Blackstone, GV, Norwest Venture Partners, and True Ventures.

productsAndServices.description: A unified identity security and access governance platform that maps identities, permissions, applications, infrastructure, and data to support visibility, authorization, reviews, and lifecycle management.
productsAndServices.name: Veza Access Platform

productsAndServices.description: A graph-based access analysis system that connects identities to effective permissions and shows who can take which actions on specific applications, systems, and data resources.
productsAndServices.name: Veza Access Graph

productsAndServices.description: An AI-assisted identity security capability that uses natural-language interaction to search enterprise access relationships, identify risk, and support least-privilege and compliance decisions.
productsAndServices.name: Veza Access AI

productsAndServices.description: A continuous identity-risk monitoring and governance capability for finding excessive privileges, dormant accounts, access drift, misconfigurations, and other weaknesses across cloud, SaaS, and hybrid environments.
productsAndServices.name: Identity Security Posture Management (ISPM)

productsAndServices.description: A set of access governance capabilities for conducting risk-informed access reviews, managing identity lifecycles and requests, enforcing authorization policies, and evaluating separation-of-duties conflicts.
productsAndServices.name: Identity Governance and Administration (IGA)

productsAndServices.description: Security and governance for service accounts, machine identities, application identities, and other non-human principals, including visibility into ownership, permissions, usage, and privilege risk.
productsAndServices.name: Non-Human Identity (NHI) Security

aiResearchSummary.text: Veza is researching generation of effective permissions from identity and access management policies, access privilege removal based on efficient access privilege usage monitoring, and automated and intelligent review of access decisions. It develops consistent rule based policy enforcement for access authorization, acceleration and deduplication of privilege graph traversal, enforcement of authorization rules across data environments, and a framework for pushing access privilege information from data environments. These efforts focus on authorization, privilege optimization, and graph based access modeling.
